query: my boss fired me without any notice period
answer:
An employer may dismiss without notice for misconduct after a due inquiry [1], and source [2] sets payment rules for some no-notice terminations by an employer. The sources do not say whether your own dismissal was lawful.

## Dismissal without notice for misconduct
- An employer may dismiss an employee without notice on grounds of misconduct inconsistent with the express or implied conditions of service, but this is after a due inquiry [1].
- Instead of dismissal, the employer may downgrade the employee or impose another lesser punishment it considers just and fit [1].
- If the punishment is suspension without wages, it cannot be longer than two weeks [1].

## Pay after a no-notice termination by the employer
- Where an employer terminates the contract without notice under the provisions covered by source [2], wages earned up to and including the day before termination takes effect, less deductions the employer may make, must be paid no later than the day the contract is terminated [2].
- In the case covered by that source where an indemnity is payable, it must also be paid by the day the contract is terminated [2].
